updates.name: Discord Patch Notes: August 4, 2026
updates.affects: Discord desktop / Windows / macOS / Linux / overlay / voice / streaming / client reliability
updates.verdict: Review the Desktop sections for fixes that apply to your setup; rollout timing may vary by platform.
updates.reasoning: Derived from Discord’s official technical Patch Notes. Service-status incidents are excluded because they are not installable client releases.
changelog: We upgraded our Desktop client to using Electron 42, which aside from general maintenance best practices on our end, yielded some incremental improvements to CPU usage of our app.
We've made language and style updates across several settings pages, including Data & Privacy and Activity Privacy.
Activity is now Games & Apps
Content & Social is now Messaging Permissions
Related settings, such as Authorized Apps/Connections and OS-specific pages/keybinds, have been consolidated for clarity.
General: Resolved an issue on Desktop where changing your email could fail after completing a CAPTCHA, leaving you unable to update your email address.
General: Fixed a bug on Desktop where having the overlay enabled could turn your entire client for certain games black when tabbed out.
General: Fixed a bug on Desktop where the overlay's chat widget couldn't be dragged to reposition it when a server was selected.
General: Fixed an issue on Desktop where dragging a server icon in the overlay could accidentally grab the image and leave the chat widget stuck to your cursor.
General: Fixed an issue on Desktop where creating a group DM from the game overlay would open the modal in the main Discord window instead of the overlay.
General: Resolved a bug on Desktop where long server names were cut off in the profile Activity card when you joined a voice channel.
Chat: Fixed an issue on Desktop where pasting a large number of emojis at once could cause the app to freeze or crash.

riskFactors.text: Discord notes that fixes may roll out gradually by client platform.

updates.name: Discord Patch Notes: July 7, 2026
updates.affects: Discord desktop / Windows / macOS / Linux / overlay / voice / streaming / client reliability
updates.verdict: Review the Desktop sections for fixes that apply to your setup; rollout timing may vary by platform.
updates.reasoning: Derived from Discord’s official technical Patch Notes. Service-status incidents are excluded because they are not installable client releases.
changelog: In early June, we shipped the iOS migration to React Native's New Architecture, Fabric. We're measuring almost 20% wins in typical app initialization times from this effort. This also should unlock some larger scale projects to help us improve reliability and performance across both Android and iOS in the future.

Looping GIFs and videos should now properly loop on Linux. We don't want to write an entire engineering blog about this, but the fix for this issue was pretty deep in the stack. I promise it wasn't something stupid like "oh, we didn't set `loop` to 1 on Linux.”

Have you ever wanted to forward a message to someone’s DMs at 3am and had to deliberate on whether or not to ping them while they’re asleep or Copy/Paste the message itself so you could send it with @silent-ly? Worry no more: message forwarding now supports @silent.

Years ago, we introduced a feature specifically for Community-enabled servers called Channel Pinning, which allowed you to move your favorite channels to the top of the channel list, just for yourself. It's now available on all servers, not just Community-enabled ones. Enjoy!

We made a small improvement to our start session logic that reduced p95/p99 session connection times by about 100ms. We literally just flipped a boolean in a config to yield this, and didn't lose anything meaningful from the swap. (I’m always saying “I flip booleans in configs to yield stuff.”)
Chat: Fixed an issue on Desktop where opening a channel where the most recent messages were all from blocked users could cause a JS crash.
Chat: Fixed a bug on Desktop where applying a spelling suggestion in Text in Voice chat didn't work while in fullscreen call view.
Audio/Video: Fixed a bug on Desktop where clicking a game's title in a voice popout with rich presence wouldn't open the game details after the first try.
Audio/Video: Resolved a bug on Desktop where the voice user popover showed an "Ask to Join" button for an embedded activity that was actually open to everyone. It now correctly shows "Join.”
Audio/Video: Fixed a bug on Desktop where the avatars in the voice channel facepile were misaligned, sitting at the bottom of the pill instead of centered.
Audio/Video: Resolved an issue on Desktop where clicking a user's icon in a collapsed voice channel didn't open their profile popout.
Audio/Video: Resolved a bug on Desktop where several guild sidebar popovers in the voice experience displayed with incorrect padding, spacing, and text alignment.
